source.notes: Red Chiba façade: vertical inset with straight central stairs and the door landing, leaning flaps with stepped solar panels (left) and a plexiglass solarium (right), a plexiglass end wall with a door, and a separate kitchen. March façade photos, the 2024 front and solarium photos, January aerials; trailer locations may have changed.
limitations: Rack bays set to nominal 12 ft. Photographic placement is approximate; this is not a measured inventory or survey.
